evals.expected_output: Author Nix with sorted keys, inline single-use let bindings, no explanatory comments, and nix fmt applied — and skips adding an option the defaults already cover.
evals.prompt: I need to add a new option to a machines profile module and wire it into the flake. Write it the shikanime way.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-nix-authoring'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body states nix fmt owns formatting and the file must be fmt-checked after editing
Body states sorted keys / record-literal style is the house norm (dotted assignment for one leaf, record literal with sorted keys for two or more)
Body states single-use let bindings should be inlined unless the name carries meaning the expression lacks
Body states explanatory comments inside .nix are out of fashion and a comment restating the code should be deleted
Body states a new option should only be added when a real non-default consumer exists, and defaults that mirror upstream should not be restated
Body refers to sks-dev for the nix fmt whole-tree caveat (do not run bare nix fmt across non-Nix files / .enc.*)

evals.expected_output: Refuses to add a wrapper module or package wrap that only restates a default, and refuses to add an option with no live non-default consumer.
evals.prompt: I want to add a wrapper module that re-exposes another module's option with the same default, and a new config option in case someone wants it later. Is that the right call?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-nix-authoring'

Body states a wrapper module that re-exposes another module's option with the same default adds surface and zero behavior and should be removed
Body states a package wrap that only sets the default flags upstream already sets should use upstream directly
Body states an option added 'in case we need it later' is premature and should not be added
Body states defaults that mirror upstream default should not be restated as local defaults
